| M-048 | Requalify upgrades | ✅ Principle; local compliance still checked [R5] [E6] | ◐ Model/config selection; current behavior must be requalified [C1] [C2] | ◐ Model aliases/overrides; pin actual selection and requalify [A9] | partial: Source/package versions are preserved; current host/model behavior has not been fully requalified. | A dependency change does not silently inherit obsolete claims. | Last qualified configuration versus one explicitly changed host/model/tool. | Pass affected regression/compatibility cases; withhold old performance claims if relevant behavior changes. | Behavior drift, silent model overrides, changed bills/tools. | L→Q | Keep, adapt or roll back the changed configuration. |
| M-049 | Independent reproduction | ✅ Principle; local compliance still checked [R5] [E6] | ◐ Source/CLI tools available; independent evidence reproduction is extra [C7] [E6] | ◐ CLI/workflow scripts available; independent reproduction is extra [A3] [A5] | open: Release checks pass; independent clean-room performance reproduction is not recorded. | Someone else can reconstruct the published evidence without private state. | Author-local replay versus clean-room replay of the shareable bundle. | Reproduce declared outputs/identities and disclose dependencies; stop claims needing undisclosed state. | Missing artifacts, private dependencies, reconstruction burden. | L→Q | Publish a reproducible bounded claim. |
| M-050 | Retire expired features | ❔ Exact local benefit unproven  | ? No automatic retirement decision for Gauntlet's added policies established  | ? No automatic retirement decision for Gauntlet's added policies established  | deferred: A continuing policy proposal, not proof that any particular feature can already be removed. | Removing a previously adopted feature after host/workload changes improves current net value; initial prompt cleanup is covered by 31. | Retain versus reversibly remove the feature on the current host. | At least 25% lower attributable overhead with no acceptance drop or critical regression; include maintenance and support. | Removal regressions, hidden dependencies, savings that vanish after repair. | L→S | Retire unsupported complexity or restore it. |
